war_summary: War 139 is on day 119 with no winner. Colonials hold a dominant strategic position with approximately 185 bases to Wardens' 65 across 40 regions. The most intense combat zones are Endless Shore, Callahans Passage, Clahstra, Marban Hollow, Onyx, and Speaking Woods, where both factions are sustaining heavy casualties with accelerating trends and active base flipping. Endless Shore shows the highest intensity (~1,000+ casualties/hr per side) with 53 events/24h across 5 active bases and a latest event at 14:41 UTC. Callahans Passage follows with ~300-400 casualties/hr per side and 6 events/24h. Clahstra has surged dramatically to ~2,200-1,600 casualties/hr per side with 11 events/24h across 3 highly active bases and a latest event at 07:41 UTC. Marban Hollow has accelerated to ~900-870 casualties/hr per side with 7 events/24h and a latest event at 06:56 UTC. Onyx has spiked to ~800-950 casualties/hr per side with 5 events/24h and a latest event at 12:21 UTC. Speaking Woods maintains ~900-880 casualties/hr per side with 4 events/24h and a latest event at 03:29 UTC. Wardens hold quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Reaching Trail) but face heavy pressure in Speaking Woods. Large Colonial rear areas (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, etc.) are quiet with minimal casualties.
